candidates.change_summary: Remove resetting of _locked to false after the function body so reentrancy lock stays true permanently, changing whether subsequent airDrop calls succeed.
Remove the hasNoBalance modifier from airDrop so callers with existing balances can receive more tokens, changing tokenBalance outcomes for callers and potentially other keys via supportsToken check.
Change supportsToken to compare against a different string so the modifier rejects calls from the Bank implementation, preventing airDrop and leaving balances unchanged.
Invert hasNoBalance to require that the caller already has a positive balance, allowing only existing holders to airDrop and thus altering which addresses' balances can change.
Replace the increment of tokenBalance by 20 with increment by 40 so airDrop gives a different balance.
Remove the balance change so airDrop no longer increases tokenBalance.
Make the nonReentrant modifier not reset the lock after execution, which can change whether subsequent airDrop calls succeed and thus observed balances across sequences.
Change the supportsToken modifier to compare against a different string, causing supportsToken check to fail and preventing airDrop from changing balance.

Relax hasNoBalance to require tokenBalance[msg.sender] <= 0 instead of == 0 (equivalent in unsigned but kept to show a mutant that changes semantics in edge cases), altering whether airDrop can run for certain callers.
